headings: Comprehensive Family of Connectivity Solutions: Our extensive solutions portfolio includes ZeroFlap AECs, Optical PAM4 DSPs, PCIe retimers, Line Card PHYs, SerDes Chiplets for Multi-Chip
Culture of Continuous Innovation: We have a history of innovation and pioneering new technologies including:
paragraphs: At Credo, our mission is to transform connectivity at scale through fast, reliable and energy-efficient system solutions. The Company's highspeed copper and optical interconnect products deliver industry-leading power and performance at up to 1.6T to meet the ever-expanding data infrastructure demands of AI. The Company's product portfolio includes ZeroFlap (ZF) Active Electrical Cables (AECs) and ZF optical transceivers, OmniConnect memory solutions and a suite of retimers and DSPs for optical and copper Ethernet and PCIe, all leveraging the Company's PILOT diagnostic and analytics software platform. The Company's innovations enable our customers to connect the systems that connect the world.

Our connectivity solutions are optimized for optical and electrical Ethernet, PCIe and emerging UALink, ESUN and SUE applications, ranging in speeds from 32G (or Gigabits per second per lane) to 200G. Our products are based on our own optimized Serializer/Deserializer (SerDes) and Digital Signal Processor (DSP) technologies. Our product families include integrated circuits (ICs), Active Electrical Cables (AECs) and SerDes Chiplets. Our intellectual property (IP) solutions consist primarily of SerDes IP licensing.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) has bred a new generation of data centers over the past 5 years that depend much more heavily on high speed, reliable communications for Front End, Scale Out, Scale Up and emerging Scale In Networks. Our proprietary SerDes and DSP technologies enable us to achieve similar performance to leading competitors' products but at a lower cost and more highly available legacy node (n-1 advantage). Beyond power and performance, Credo continues to innovate to address customers' system level requirements. We partnered with Oracle to develop our ZeroFlap Optics that helps address the reliability issues known as Link Flap which plague commodity options in AI data centers enabling faster AI cluster turn on and time to first revenue.

The multibillion-dollar data infrastructure market that we serve is driven largely by hyperscale data centers (hyperscalers) and emerging NeoClouds building AI/Machine Learning (ML) Infrastructure as well as general compute and data centers. The demands for increased bandwidth, better reliability and improved power efficiency have grown as AI model sizes have increased from billions to trillions of parameters and the workload has expanded from training to inference.

We design, market and sell both product, software and IP solutions. We help define industry conventions and standards within the markets we target by collaborating with technology leaders and standards bodies. We contract with a variety of manufacturing partners to build our products based on our proprietary SerDes and DSP technologies. We develop standard solutions we can sell broadly to our end markets and also develop tailored solutions designed to address specific customer needs. Once developed, these tailored solutions can generally be broadly leveraged across our portfolio and we are able to sell the part or license the IP to the broader market.

We have global sales, marketing and business development teams responsible for identifying and building our customer relationships. We sell our products to hyperscalers, NeoClouds and other cloud infrastructure providers. We are engaged with all of the major hyperscalers, and our customer base includes over 20 blue chip clients, including a broad mix of original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), optical module manufacturers and other leading enterprises.
During fiscal 2026 and 2025, we generated $1.3 billion and $436.8 million in total revenue, respectively.
We believe we are well positioned to benefit from the strong secular tailwinds driving the data infrastructure market, which is being driven by several factors, including:

AI/ML Drives an Explosion in Network Traffic: Our hyperscale customers are increasingly pursuing AI/ML infrastructure that requires back end scale out interconnectivity densities that are an order or magnitude higher than their general compute infrastructure. The growth of AI/ML model sizes is driving an explosion in interconnectivity traffic which enables multiple physical devices to work on the same model at high speed and low latency. Credo provides Ethernet solutions to support this type of interconnectivity, and we believe that Ethernet has now become the standard for back end scale out networks.

Back end scale up networks have grown from an appliance scale of 8 GPUs to rack scale of 72 GPUs in calendar 2024 and there is strong interest in growing this to scale in the coming years. Scale up networks are already 10x denser than scale out networks, a full 100x denser than front end networks. Scale up network architectures are dominated by Ethernet and PCIe PHYs at layer 1 with proprietary extensions at higher levels.

Hyperscaler General Compute Traffic Doubles Every 2-3 Years: Our hyperscale customers began to deploy front end Network Interface Card (NIC) speeds of 200G in calendar year 2023, 400G in calendar year 2024 and 800G in calendar year 2025. As NIC speeds double, there is a need for higher speed east-west traffic infrastructure to support applications such as Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA), Non-volatile Memory Express (NVMe) and other high-bandwidth applications, while maintaining high reliability and observability within the power and cost constraints of a modern data center.

Hyperscalers, which have the ability to seamlessly provision and add compute, memory, networking and storage resources to a given node or set of nodes that make up a larger computing, distributed computing or grid computing environment, drive demand for high-speed, low-power connectivity solutions. Our hyperscale customers have deployed 50G per lane electrical PAM4 data rates in 2023, 100G per lane electrical PAM4 solutions in 2024 and 200G per lane PAM4 solutions planned for mass deployment in 2027.

Similarly, with the global deployment of high-speed fixed-line and wireless networks, carriers are also increasingly seeking higher performance connectivity solutions to address their substantial growth in traffic. 5G wireless infrastructure has proliferated in some countries but still has much room for growth, and low earth orbit satellite IP solutions such as Starlink offer disruptive performance and cost for users who cannot access the existing infrastructure. Fixed-line infrastructure speeds continue to grow, with the announcement of CableLabs DOCSIS 4.0 10Gb standards and proliferation of fiber-to-the-home.

Beyond hyperscalers and 5G networking, the evolution of connectivity standards for servers such as Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) and consumer devices such as Universal Serial Bus (USB) present an additional long-term opportunity. As these connectivity standards move to higher-speed data rates and higher order modulation, innovation in power efficiency and cost efficiency will be required to deliver competitive connectivity solutions. We expect that demand for increasingly sophisticated connectivity solutions will grow alongside the evolution of these standards.

We may not be able to meet manufacturing yields that allow us to meet customer demand and maintain our gross margins.
We may be unable to develop or maintain our relationships with industry and technology leaders to enhance our product offerings.
Average selling prices of our products generally decrease over time, which could negatively impact our revenue and gross margins.
Our gross margins may fluctuate due to a variety of factors.
We may not receive timely payments from our customers, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We may not be able to accurately predict our future capital needs, and we may not be able to obtain additional financing to fund our operations.
We may not be able to effectively manage our growth without incurring significant expenditures necessary to address the additional operational and control requirements of our growth.

paragraphs: Investors in our ordinary shares hold shares of a holding company incorporated as an exempted company under the laws of the Cayman Islands rather than equity securities of our subsidiaries that have substantive business operations. Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd is a holding company incorporated as an exempted company under the laws of the Cayman Islands with no operations of its own. We conduct substantially all of our operations through our indirect, wholly-owned subsidiaries in the United States and internationally. Investing in our ordinary shares involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this filing, including our audited consolidated financial statements and related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," before investing in our ordinary shares. If any of the following risks are realized, in whole or in part, our business, results of operations and financial condition could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the price of our ordinary shares could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair the operation of our business.

We depend on a limited number of customers for a substantial portion of our revenue. The loss of, or a significant reduction in sales to, one or more of our major customers could negatively impact our revenue and operating results.

In fiscal 2026, we had two customers that accounted for 10% or more of our total revenue. In addition, in fiscal 2026, sales to our top 10 customers accounted for approximately 90% of our total revenue. We believe our operating results for the foreseeable future will continue to depend on sales to a relatively small number of customers. In the future, these customers may decide not to purchase our products or solutions at all, may purchase fewer products or solutions than they did in the past or may alter their purchasing patterns.

In addition, our relationships with some customers may deter other potential customers who compete with these customers from buying our products. To attract new customers or retain existing customers, we may offer these customers favorable terms, including the right to terminate or delay orders on little notice, exclusivity or most favored nation pricing on our products. Such agreements could impair our operating results. In the event of pricing reductions or financial incentives for key customers, our average selling prices and gross margins would decline. The loss of a key customer, any reduction in sales to any key customer or our inability to attract new significant customers could negatively impact our revenue and materially and adversely affect our business or results of operations.

Substantially all of our product sales to date have been made on a purchase order basis. We generally do not obtain long-term commitments with our customers or commitments for minimum purchases from our customers. Our arrangements with our customers permit our customers to cancel, change or delay their product purchase orders upon specified notice and subject to negotiated limitations. In some cases, our customers may cancel purchase orders on relatively short notice to us and without penalty to them. In addition, customers may delay delivery of orders to a subsequent fiscal quarter. Our revenue and operating results have, and could in the future, fluctuate materially and have, and could in the future, be materially and disproportionately impacted by the purchasing decisions of our customers, especially our larger customers. Our customers may decide to purchase fewer units than they have in the past, alter their purchasing patterns at any time with limited notice, change the terms on which they are prepared to do business with us or decide not to continue to purchase our products at all, any of which could cause our revenue to decline materially and materially harm our business, financial condition and

results of operations. Cancellations of, reductions in or rescheduling of customer orders could also result in the loss of anticipated sales without allowing us sufficient time to reduce our inventory and operating expenses, as a substantial portion of our expenses are fixed at least in the short term. In addition, changes in forecasts or the timing of orders expose us to the risks of inventory shortages or excess inventory. Any of the foregoing events could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

We are a product-focused business with a strong foundation in IP, pioneering comprehensive connectivity solutions that deliver bandwidth, scalability and end-to-end signal integrity for next-generation platforms.

We utilize a fabless business model, working with a network of third parties to manufacture, assemble and test our connectivity products. This approach allows us to focus our engineering and design resources on our core competencies and to control our fixed costs and capital expenditures.

We employ a two-pronged sales strategy targeting both the end users of our products, as well as the suppliers of our end users. By engaging directly with the end user, we are able to better understand the needs of our customers and cater our solutions to their most pressing connectivity requirements.

headings: 完整的連線解決方案：我們廣泛的解決方案產品組合包括 ZeroFlap AECs、Optical PAM4 DSPs、PCIe retimers、Line Card PHYs、用於多晶片的 SerDes Chiplets
持續創新文化：我們有創新歷史，並先導新技術包括：
我們的產品與解決方案
paragraphs: 在 Credo，我們的使命是透過快速、可靠且節能的系統解決方案，來轉型大規模的連接。本公司高速銅線與光纖連接產品，可提供業界領先的電力與性能，最高達 1.6T，以符合 AI 不斷擴張的資料基礎建設需求。本公司產品組合包括 ZeroFlap (ZF) 主動電氣纜線 (AECs) 與 ZF 光學收發器、OmniConnect 記憶體解決方案，以及一套用於光纖與銅線乙太網與 PCIe 的重複器與 DSP，皆基於本公司 PILOT 診斷與分析軟體平台。本公司創新技術使我們的客戶能夠連接連接世界的系統。

我們的連接解決方案針對光纖與電氣乙太網、PCIe 以及新興的 UALink、ESUN 與 SUE 應用進行優化，速度範圍從 32G（或每通道每秒吉比特）至 200G。我們的產品基於本公司自行優化的序列化/反序列化 (SerDes) 與數位訊號處理器 (DSP) 技術。我們的產品系列包括積體電路 (ICs)、主動電氣纜線 (AECs) 與 SerDes 封裝晶片。我們的智慧財產權 (IP) 解決方案主要為 SerDes IP 授權。

人工智慧 (AI) 在過去 5 年催生了新一代的資料中心，這些資料中心更依賴高速、可靠的通訊來處理前端、擴展式、擴充式以及新興的收縮式網路。我們的專有 SerDes 與 DSP 技術使我們能夠達到與領先競爭對手產品相似的性能，但成本更低，且具有更高的可用性遺產節點 (n-1 優勢)。除了電力與性能，Credo 仍持續創新以解決客戶的系統層需求。我們與 Oracle 合作開發 ZeroFlap 光學產品，以解決 AI 資料中心中常見的 Link Flap 可靠性問題，使 AI 羣集啟動更快，並縮短首次營收時間。
我們服務的數十億美元資料基礎建設市場，主要由超規模資料中心 (hyperscalers) 與新興的 NeoClouds 所驅動，這些 NeoClouds 正在建設 AI/機器學習 (ML) 基礎建設，以及一般計算與資料中心。隨著 AI 模型規模從十億到萬億參數增加，且工作負載從訓練擴展至推理，對增加頻寬、更好可靠性與改進電力效率的需求也持續成長。

我們設計、行銷與銷售產品、軟體與 IP 解決方案。我們透過與科技領導者與標準機構合作，協助定義我們目標市場的產業慣例與標準。我們與多種製造夥伴合作，根據我們的專有 SerDes 與 DSP 技術來製造產品。我們開發標準解決方案，可廣泛銷售至終端市場，同時也開發客製化解決方案，以解決特定客戶需求。一旦開發完成，這些客製化解決方案通常可以廣泛應用於我們的產品組合，我們也能將零件銷售或授權 IP 給更廣泛的市場。
我們有全球的銷售、行銷與業務發展團隊，負責識別與建立客戶關係。我們將產品銷售給超規模資料中心、NeoClouds 以及其他雲端基礎建設供應商。我們與所有主要的超規模資料中心都有合作，客戶羣包括超過 20 家藍籌客戶，包括廣泛的原始設備製造商 (OEMs)、原始設計製造商 (ODMs)、光學模組製造商及其他領導企業。
在會計年度 2026 與 2025，我們分別實現了總營收 13 億美元與 43.68 億美元。
我們相信我們處於有利位置，能夠受益於推動資料基礎建設市場的強勁長期趨勢，這些趨勢由多種因素驅動，包括：
AI/ML 帶動網路流量爆炸性成長：本公司超大型客戶 increasingly 追求 AI/ML 基礎設施，此類基礎設施需要後端擴展式互聯密度，其程度比一般計算基礎設施高一個或數個等級。AI/ML 模型規模的成長正驅動互聯流量的爆炸性成長，使多臺實體裝置能夠以高速且低延遲的方式共同處理同一模型。Credo 提供乙太網路解決方案以支援此類互聯，我們認為乙太網路已成為後端擴展式網路的標準。
後端擴展式網路從 2024 年歷曆年份的 8 個 GPU 裝置規模成長至機架規模的 72 個 GPU，未來幾年有強烈興趣將此規模進一步擴展。擴展式網路架構目前已比擴展式網路密集 10 倍，比前端網路密集 100 倍。擴展式網路架構在第一層由乙太網路和 PCIe PHYs 主導，更高層則有專屬的擴展。
超大型客戶一般計算流量每 2 至 3 年倍增：本公司超大型客戶於 2023 年開始部署前端網路介面卡 (NIC) 200G 速度，2024 年為 400G，2025 年為 800G。隨著 NIC 速度倍增，需要更高速度的東西向流量基礎設施以支援如遠端直接記憶體存取 (RDMA)、非揮發性記憶體快取 (NVMe) 等高頻寬應用，同時維持現代資料中心的電力與成本限制下的高可靠性與可觀察性。
擁有能力無縫配置與增加計算、記憶體、網路與儲存資源至特定節點或節點組的超大型客戶，驅動對高速、低功耗連接解決方案的需求。本公司超大型客戶於 2023 年部署了每通道 50G 電氣 PAM4 資料速率，2024 年部署了每通道 100G 電氣 PAM4 解決方案，並計畫於 2027 年進行大規模部署的每通道 200G PAM4 解決方案。

同樣地，隨著全球高速固定線與無線網路的部署，電信業者也日益尋求更高性能的連接解決方案以應對其流量的大幅成長。5G 無線基礎設施已在某些國家普及，但仍有很大的成長空間，而低軌道衛星 IP 解決方案如 Starlink 則為無法接取現有基礎設施的用戶提供具有顛覆性表現與成本的解決方案。固定線基礎設施速度持續成長，CableLabs 宣佈 DOCSIS 4.0 10Gb 標準，並持續擴展至家庭的光纖網路。
除了超大型客戶與 5G 網路之外，伺服器連接標準如外設元件互連快速 (PCIe) 與消費者裝置如通用序列匯流排 (USB) 的連接標準演進，也帶來額外的長期機會。隨著這些連接標準轉向更高的資料速率與更高階的調變技術，創新在電力效率與成本效率方面將被需要，以提供具有競爭力的連接解決方案。我們預期，這些標準的演進將伴隨對更複雜連接解決方案需求的成長。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度10-K申報表中其他地方所包含的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。本討論包含風險與不確定性之向前看聲明。我們實際結果可能與這些向前看聲明所討論的結果有重大差異。導致這種差異的因素包括下列所識別的以及在「風險因素」部分所討論的。

有關我們財務狀況及我們在2026年財務年度（截至2026年5月2日）與2025年財務年度（截至2025年5月3日）營運成果的討論，請見下文。有關我們在2025年財務年度（截至2025年5月3日）與2024年財務年度（截至2024年4月27日）營運成果的討論，請參閱我們2025年財務年度（截至2025年5月3日）的10-K申報表中「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析」部分，該申報表於2025年7月2日提交給SEC。

在Credo，我們的使命是透過快速、可靠且節能的系統解決方案，實現大規模連接。本公司高速銅線與光纖連接產品，提供行業領先的電力與性能，最高達1.6T，以符合AI不斷擴張的資料基礎設施需求。本公司產品組合包括ZeroFlap（ZF）主動電氣纜線（AECs）與ZF光學轉接器、OmniConnect記憶體解決方案，以及一套用於光學與銅線以太網與PCIe的重複器與數位訊號處理器（DSPs），皆基於PILOT診斷與分析軟體平台。我們的創新使客戶得以連接連接這個世界的系統。
我們的連接解決方案針對光學與電氣以太網、PCIe以及新興的UALink、ESUN與SUE應用進行優化，速度範圍從32G（或每通道每秒千位元）至200G。我們的產品基於我們自有的優化序列化/反序列化（SerDes）與DSP技術。我們的產品系列包括整合電路（ICs）、主動電氣纜線（AECs）與SerDes晶片。我們的智慧財產權（IP）解決方案主要為SerDes IP授權。

過去5年，人工智慧（AI）催生了一代新的資料中心，這些資料中心更依賴高速、可靠的通訊來處理前端、擴展式、擴充式以及新興的縮放式網路。我們的專有SerDes與DSP技術使我們能達到與領先競爭對手產品相似的性能，但成本更低且具有更高的可用性遺留節點（n-1優勢）。除了電力與性能，Credo持續創新以解決客戶的系統層需求。我們與Oracle合作開發ZeroFlap光學，以解決AI資料中心中常見的連接跳動（Link Flap）問題，使商品化選項能更快啟動AI叢集並縮短首次營收時間。
我們服務的多十億美元資料基礎設施市場，主要由超規模資料中心（hyperscalers）與新興的NeoClouds所驅動，這些NeoClouds正在建設AI/機器學習（ML）基礎設施，以及一般計算與資料中心。隨著AI模型規模從十億到十萬億參數增加，且工作負載從訓練擴展到推理，對增加頻寬、更好可靠性與改善電力效率的需求也持續成長。
我們設計、行銷與銷售產品、軟體與IP解決方案。我們透過與科技領導者與標準機構合作，協助定義我們目標市場的產業慣例與標準。我們與多種製造夥伴合作，根據我們專有的SerDes與DSP技術來製造產品。我們開發標準解決方案，可廣泛銷售至終端市場，同時也開發針對特定客戶需求的客製化解決方案。一旦開發完成，這些客製化解決方案通常可廣泛應用於我們的產品組合，我們也能將零件銷售或授權IP給更廣泛的市場。
在2026財務年度與2025財務年度，我們分別產生總營收13億美元與43.68億美元。從地理分佈來看，2026財務年度與2025財務年度總營收中，有58%與15%來自北美地區的客戶，而42%與85%則來自其餘世界地區的客戶，主要為亞洲地區。在2026財務年度與2025財務年度，我們分別產生淨收入47.23億美元與5.22億美元。
我們從有限數量的客戶取得絕大多數的營業收入。我們預期在可預見的未來，仍將從有限數量的客戶取得相當大比例的營業收入。我們預期，隨著我們的產品被更廣泛採用，且客戶數量增加，客戶集中度將會降低。

我們將產品銷售給超大型資料中心運營商、新興雲端服務商、原始設備製造商（OEMs）、原始設計製造商（ODMs）、製造商（CM）以及光模組製造商，以及在企業和高性能計算（HPC）市場的公司。我們與這些領域的行業領導公司密切合作，並有相關合作關係。歷史上，相對少數的客戶已佔據並持續佔據我們營業收入的相當大比例。我們在財務說明中按客戶歸類營業收入，根據與我們簽訂採購訂單或簽訂營業收入合約的 contracting parties。請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表中所附的審計合併財務報表附註 3。然而，我們某些最終客戶的合同製造商會向我們下訂單。因此，合同製造商，而非最終客戶，被視為我們的客戶，用於財務報告目的。作為我們財務說明附註的補充，並提供進一步瞭解我們最終客戶集中度的資訊，以下表格總結了我們的營業收入按客戶佔總營業收入的百分比，根據最終客戶的類型，而非根據下訂單或簽訂營業收入合約的 contracting parties：

我們是一家以產品為核心的公司，擁有強大的智慧財產權基礎，開創性地提供全面的連接解決方案，為下一代平台提供頻寬、可擴展性及端到端訊號完整性。
我們採用無晶圓廠商業模式，與第三方網路合作製造、組裝及測試我們的連接產品。這種方式使我們能專注於工程與設計資源在核心競爭優勢上，並控制固定成本及資本支出。
我們採用雙管齊下的銷售策略，同時針對我們產品的最終用戶以及最終用戶的供應商。透過直接與最終用戶合作，我們能更深入瞭解客戶需求，並針對他們最迫切的連接需求調整解決方案。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們並未與客戶簽訂長期採購承諾，若客戶取消或變更採購訂單，將可能使我們的營業收入與營運成果受到影響。
我們面臨總體經濟風險，包括但不限於經濟衰退、通貨膨脹、停滯性通貨膨脹及其他經濟狀況。
全球貿易政策的變動，包括關稅、制裁及貿易壁壘，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與前景產生不利影響。
我們在過去期間已產生淨虧損，並累積虧損，未來可能產生額外的淨虧損。
我們面臨激烈的競爭，並預期未來競爭將進一步增加。
我們可能產生大量費用以開發、行銷及取得產品認證，但這些產品可能無法產生任何收入。
我們產品的成功在部分程度上依賴客戶開發能獲得市場接受度的產品能力，而客戶可能無法做到此點。
本公司通常不會與臺積電或其他第三方製造商或供應商簽訂長期供應契約，且任何產品或材料供應中斷，包括
原物料價格波動，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司依賴使用第三方技術及其成功開發產品的能力，若未來無法使用這些技術，將會影響本公司維持競爭力的能力。
本公司可能無法達到製造良率，以滿足客戶需求並維持毛利率。
本公司可能無法開發或維持與產業及科技領導者之關係，以提升產品組合。
本公司產品之平均售價通常會隨時間下降，這可能會對營業收入及毛利率造成負面影響。
本公司毛利率可能因多種因素而波動。
本公司可能無法從客戶取得及時付款，這可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成不利影響。
我們可能無法準確預測未來的資金需求，且可能無法取得額外融資以支應營運資金。
我們可能無法在不產生重大支出的情況下有效管理成長，以應對成長所帶來的額外營運與控制需求。
若我們無法保留任何協助銷售產品的經銷商，或這些經銷商未能如預期表現，可能會降低我們未來的銷售額。
環境法規或政策的變更，以及永續發展計畫，可能產生重大成本，並可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們有風險會被認定為現行或未來任何課稅年度的被動外國投資公司，這通常會導致
paragraphs: 投資人持有本公司普通股，係持有在開曼羣島依據當地法律註冊為豁免公司之控股公司股份，而非持有實際進行營運之子公司之權益證券。Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd 為一在開曼羣島依據當地法律註冊為豁免公司之控股公司，本身無實際營運。本公司 substantially all 之營運係透過美國及國際間之間接、 wholly-owned 子公司進行。投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考量下列所描述之風險與不確定性，並配合本檔所有其他資訊，包括本公司經審計之合併財務報表及其附註，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」，再決定是否投資本公司普通股。若任何下列風險實現，無論全部或部分，將可能對本公司營運、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大且不利影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股之價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性，亦可能影響本公司營運。
我們依賴極少數客戶來獲取營收之大部分。若失去任何一位主要客戶，或對該客戶銷售大幅減少，將可能對我們之營收與營運結果造成負面影響。
在財務年度 2026 年，我們有兩位客戶佔總營收 10% 或以上。此外，在財務年度 2026 年，我們前十大客戶之銷售佔總營收約 90%。我們認為，在可預見之未來，我們之營運結果仍將依賴較少數之客戶銷售。未來，這些客戶可能決定完全不購買我們之產品或解決方案，或購買較少產品或解決方案，或改變其採購模式。

此外，我們與部分客戶之關係可能使其他與這些客戶競爭之潛在客戶不願購買我們之產品。為吸引新客戶或留住現有客戶，我們可能為這些客戶提供有利條件，包括可於短時間內終止或延後訂單之權利、獨家權或最優惠價格。這些協議可能影響我們之營運結果。若對關鍵客戶進行價格減讓或提供財務激勵，我們之平均銷售價格與毛利率將下降。失去關鍵客戶、對任何關鍵客戶銷售減少，或我們無法吸引新之重要客戶，均可能對我們之營收造成負面影響，並對我們之營運或結果造成重大且不利影響。

截至目前為止，我們之產品銷售幾乎全部係以採購訂單方式進行。我們通常不會與客戶取得長期承諾或最低採購量之承諾。我們與客戶之協議允許客戶在指定通知期間內取消、變更或延後其產品採購訂單，並受協議限制。在某些情況下，客戶可能在相對短時間內取消採購訂單，且對其自身無罰則。此外，客戶可能將訂單交付延後至下一財務季度。我們之營收與營運結果已，且可能在未來大幅波動，並已，且可能在未來大幅且不成比例地受到客戶之採購決定影響，特別是我們之大型客戶。客戶可能決定購買較少單位，或在短時間內改變其採購模式，或改變其願意與我們進行業務之條件，或決定完全不繼續購買我們之產品，任何一種情況均可能導致我們之營收大幅下降，並對我們之營運、財務狀況與
營運結果造成重大損害。客戶訂單之取消、減少或重新排程，也可能導致我們失去預期銷售，而無法給予我們足夠時間來降低存貨與營運費用，因我們之大部分費用在短時間內為固定費用。此外，預測之變動或訂單時間之改變，使我們面臨存貨不足或過多之風險。任何上述事件均可能對我們之營運、財務狀況與營運結果造成重大且不利影響。
